name: Travel Case
instruction: Start with a rectangular box with rounded corners. Add a handle on top and two latches on the front. Include a hinge along the back edge to allow the case to open. Inside, create a simple compartmentalized layout with a few dividers.

Shape accuracy: The object is a rectangular box.
The handle is positioned on top of the box.
The front of the box features two latches.
A hinge is located along the back edge.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The hinge is proportionate to the travel case.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The handle is correctly placed for ergonomic use.
The latches are positioned for easy access.
The hinge is aligned with the back edge for proper opening.
The dividers are evenly spaced within the compartment.
Object distance and contact: The handle does not interfere with the latches.
The latches do not obstruct the opening of the box.
The dividers do not extend beyond the interior walls.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
The design adheres to the instruction details without omission.
